title: Deploy Gates: Gold, Canary, Rollback
objective: After this lesson you will be able to gate deploys on gold behavior evals, analyze canaries with multi-metric vetoes, trigger automatic rollbacks, and kill instantly via feature flags.
why: Code gates pass while behavior regresses: a prompt tweak tanks VIP handling, a model swap shifts tone, a reranker change drops prices. Behavior gates (gold sets + canary analysis + auto-rollback) catch what unit tests structurally cannot. Shipping AI without them is hoping at scale — hope is not a deploy strategy.

blocks.text: Every deploy runs the **gold conversation set** with per-segment no-regression rules (LangGraph Ch.9 / CrewAI Ch.8 discipline): overall improvement required, zero segment regressions tolerated, money/attack segments veto-weighted. Failing gold blocks the pipeline exactly like failing tests — behavior is a merge criterion, not a monitoring concern.

blocks.caption: Behavior gates with the same severity order as eval gates

blocks.text: **Canary**: route 5% traffic to the candidate, compare error/quality/cost/latency metrics against baseline over a fixed window. **Vetoes** (error spikes, safety violations) block regardless of wins; **segments** (VIP, money paths) gate independently; **aggregate gain** required last. Auto-promote on all-green, auto-rollback on veto — humans review promotions, machines execute rollbacks (speed matters more than deliberation mid-incident).

blocks.caption: Vetoes roll back, flat gains hold, all-green promotes

blocks.text: **Feature flags** separate deploy from release (ship code dark) and enable instant kills (flag off in seconds, no redeploy). Every risky change rides a flag with an owner and an expiry (flags without expiry become permanent branches). Rollback = previous gold-passing version redeployed automatically on veto — rehearsed quarterly, never improvised.

blocks.title: Gate the deploy
blocks.note: Run it: expect regression:edge (averages hide it), veto:money (gains don't excuse it), then ship true. Three verdicts, three gate layers — behavior blocking merges.

items: Gold gates block merges: no segment regressions, vetoes enforced, gains required
Canary: 5% traffic, multi-metric vetoes, auto-rollback on breach, auto-promote on green
Flags separate deploy from release; kills instant; rollbacks rehearsed, never improvised

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice gate on all three candidates and map verdicts to layers. (b) Write the canary verdict for: errors +15%, quality +5%, cost −10% — with the action and reason. (c) State the flag policy for a refund-policy rewrite (owner, expiry, kill condition).
hints: Verdicts: regression:edge / veto:money / ship:true — vetoes, segments, gains in order.
Canary: error regression vetoes → rollback, despite quality/cost wins. Vetoes overrule improvements, always.
Flag: owner named, 14-day expiry, kill on any money-segment dip or veto — flags with owners and deaths, never orphans.
exercise.why: Layered verdicts (vetoes → segments → gains), canary veto logic, and flag hygiene (owners + expiries) are the three deploy judgments — each verified against concrete candidates.
exercise.code: // Gate-order pattern: vetoes, segments, gains — for gold and canary alike.

quiz.q: Deploy beats baseline overall, regresses edge. Ship?
options: No: per-segment no-regression gate — localized harm blocks regardless of averages
quiz.explain: Segment gates exist because averages hide localized harm. Fix the segment, then ship the gain.

options: Rollback: error veto overrules all wins — vetoes exist precisely for attractive-but-harmful candidates
quiz.explain: Vetoes (errors, safety) are non-compensatory: no win offsets them. Roll back automatically, investigate deliberately.

quiz.q: Feature flag without owner or expiry. Status?
options: Orphaned branch-in-waiting: flags need owners + expiries or they fossilize into permanent conditional complexity
quiz.explain: Flags are temporary by design: owners retire them, expiries force the question. Orphan flags rot into untested branches.

summary: Gold gates block merges, canaries analyze with vetoes, flags kill instantly, rollbacks rehearse. Behavior ships on proof, never hope.
next: Shippable process — now the walls: injection at scale, PII, rate limits, and output filters. Next: production guardrails.
